βίβλος.g: a written book, roll, or volume
βίβλος.d: a written book, roll, or volume, sometimes with a sacred connotation.

Ἰησοῦς.c: Ἰησοῦς, οῦ, ὁ, acc. οῦν, dat. οῦ, voc. οῦ
Ἰησοῦς.d: Jesus; the Greek form of Joshua; Jesus, son of Eliezer; Jesus, surnamed Justus.

Ἀβραάμ.d: Abraham, progenitor of the Hebrew race.

γεννάω.g: I beget, bring forth, give birth to
γεννάω.d: I beget (of the male), (of the female) I bring forth, give birth to.

δέ.g: but, on the other hand, and
δέ.d: a weak adversative particle, generally placed second in its clause; but, on the other hand, and.

Ἰακώβ.d: (Hebrew), Jacob, (a) the patriarch, son of Isaac, (b) father of Joseph, the husband of Mary.

ἀδελφός.d: a brother, member of the same religious community, especially a fellow-Christian.

αὐτός.g: he, she, it, they, them, same
αὐτός.d: he, she, it, they, them, same.

Φαρές.d: Perez, son of Judah and one of the ancestors of Jesus.

Ζάρα.d: Zerah, son of Judah and Tamar.

ἐκ.g: from out, out from among, from
ἐκ.d: from out, out from among, from, suggesting from the interior outwards.

Θαμάρ.d: Tamar, mother of Perez and Zerah by Judah, son of Jacob.

Ἑσρώμ.d: Hezron, son of Perez, father of Ram.

Ἀράμ.d: Ram, son of Hezron and father of Amminadab.

Ἀμιναδάβ.d: Amminadab, son of Ram and father of Nahshon, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

Ναασσών.d: Nahshon, son of Amminadab and father of Salmon, and one of the ancestors of Jesus.

Σαλμών.d: Salmon, son of Nahshon and father of Boaz.

Ῥαχάβ.d: Rahab, a Canaanitess, who rescued the Hebrew spies at Jericho.

Ῥούθ.d: Ruth, wife of Boaz and mother of Obed.

Ἰεσσαί.d: (Hebrew), Jesse, son of Obed, and father of King David.

βασιλεύς.d: a king, ruler, but in some passages clearly to be translated: emperor.

Σολομών.d: Solomon, son of David King of Israel, and Bathsheba.

Οὐρίας.d: Uriah, husband of Bathsheba the mother of Solomon.

Ῥοβοάμ.d: Rehoboam, son of Solomon, and King of Israel.

Ἀβιά.d: Abijah, (a) a king, son of Rehoboam, (b) founder of the eighth class of priests.

Ἰωσαφάτ.d: (Hebrew), Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, son of Asaph, father of Joram, an ancestor of Jesus.

Ἰωράμ.d: (Hebrew), Joram, Jehoram, son of Jehoshaphat and father of Uzziah.

Ὀζίας.d: Uzziah, son of Joram and father of Jotham, and king of Judah from about 785 to 746 B.C., an ancestor of Jesus.

Ἰωαθάμ.d: Jotham, son of Uzziah and father of Ahaz.

Ἀχάζ.d: Ahaz, son of Jotham and father of Hezekiah.

Ἑζεκίας.d: Hezekiah, son of Ahaz, father of Manasseh, and king of Judah (727-686 [?] B.C.).

Μανασσῆς.d: (Hebrew), Manasseh, (a) son of Joseph, founder of a tribe of Israel, (b) son of Hezekiah and father of Amon (Amos).

Ἀμώς.d: Amos, son of Manasseh and father of Josiah, an ancestor of Jesus.

Ἰεχονίας.d: (Hebrew), Jechoniah, son of Josiah and father of Salathiel.

ἐπί.g: on, to, against, on the basis of, at
ἐπί.d: on, to, against, on the basis of, at.

Βαβυλών.d: (a) Babylon, the ancient city on the Euphrates, to which the people of Jerusalem, etc., were transported, (b) hence allegorically of Rome, from the point of view of the Christian people.

μετά.d: (a) gen: with, in company with, (b) acc: (1) behind, beyond, after, of place, (2) after, of time, with nouns, neut. of adjectives.

Ζοροβαβέλ.d: Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel (Salathiel) and father of Abiud and Rhesa.

Ἀβιούδ.d: Abiud, son of Zerubbabel and father of Eliakim.

Ἐλιακίμ.d: Eliakim, son of Abiud and father of Azor; son of Melea and father of Jonam.

Ἀζώρ.d: Azor, son of Eliakim and father of Zadok, an ancestor of Jesus.

Ἀχίμ.d: Achim, son of Zadok and father of Eliud.

Ἐλιούδ.d: Eliud, son of Achim, and father of Eleazar.

Ἐλεάζαρ.d: Eleazar, son of Eliud, and father of Matthan.

ἀνήρ.g: a male human being, a man
ἀνήρ.d: a male human being; a man, husband.

Μαρία.d: Mary, Miriam, (a) the mother of Jesus, (b) of Magdala, (c) sister of Martha and Lazarus, (d) wife of Cleopas, (e) mother of John Mark, (f) a Christian woman in Rome.

λέγω.d: (denoting speech in progress), (a) I say, speak; I mean, mention, tell, (b) I call, name, especially in the pass., (c) I tell, command.

πᾶς.g: all, the whole, every kind of
πᾶς.c: πᾶς, πάσα, πᾶν, gen. παντός, πάσης, παντός
πᾶς.d: all, the whole, every kind of.

γενεά.d: a generation; if repeated twice or with another time word, practically indicates infinity of time.

ἕως.d: (a) conj: until, (b) prep: as far as, up to, as much as, until.

μνηστεύομαι.d: I ask in marriage; pass: I am betrothed.

συνέρχομαι.g: I come or go with, accompany, assemble
συνέρχομαι.d: I come or go with, accompany; I come together, assemble.

εὑρίσκω.d: I find, learn, discover, especially after searching.

γαστήρ.g: the womb, stomach, to be pregnant
γαστήρ.d: the womb, stomach; of a woman: to be with child (lit: to have [a child] in the belly).

ἅγιος.d: set apart by (or for) God, holy, sacred.

δίκαιος.d: just; especially, just in the eyes of God; righteous; the elect (a Jewish idea).

θέλω.d: I will, wish, desire, am willing, intend, design.

δειγματίζω.g: I hold up as an example
δειγματίζω.d: I hold up as an example, make a show of, expose.

ἀπολύω.g: I release, let go, send away, divorce
ἀπολύω.d: I release, let go, send away, divorce, am rid; mid: I depart.

ἐνθυμέομαι.d: I meditate upon, reflect upon, ponder.

ἄγγελος.d: a messenger, generally a (supernatural) messenger from God, an angel, conveying news or behests from God to men.

κατά.g: down from, against, according to, throughout, during
κατά.d: gen: against, down from, throughout, by; acc: over against, among, daily, day-by-day, each day, according to, by way of.

φαίνω.d: (a) act: I shine, shed light, (b) pass: I shine, become visible, appear, (c) I become clear, appear, seem, show myself as.

φοβέομαι.d: I fear, dread, reverence, am afraid, terrified.

παραλαμβάνω.d: I take from, receive from, or: I take to, receive (apparently not used of money), admit, acknowledge; I take with me.

τίκτω.d: I bear, bring forth, produce, beget, yield.

καλέω.d: (a) I call, summon, invite, (b) I call, name.

λαός.d: (a) a people, characteristically of God's chosen people, first the Jews, then the Christians, (b) sometimes, but rarely, the people, the crowd.

ἁμαρτία.d: unsettled, unstable (though these are hardly strong enough equivalents), almost anarchic.

γίνομαι.g: I come into being, am born
γίνομαι.d: I come into being, am born, become, come about, happen.

διά.d: (a) gen: through, throughout, by the instrumentality of, (b) acc: through, on account of, by reason of, for the sake of, because of.

προφήτης.d: a prophet, poet; a person gifted at expositing divine truth.

παρθένος.d: a maiden, virgin; extended to men who have not known women.

Ἐμμανουήλ.d: Emmanuel, a Messianic title derived from Isaiah 7:14 = God with us.

μεθερμηνεύω.d: I translate (from one language into another), interpret.

ἐγείρω.d: (a) I wake, arouse, (b) I raise up.

ποιέω.d: (a) I make, manufacture, construct, (b) I do, act, cause.

ὡς.g: as, like as, how, while, so that
ὡς.d: as, like as, about, as it were, according as, how, when, while, as soon as, so that.

προστάσσω.d: (a) I instruct, command, (b) I appoint, assign.

γινώσκω.g: I come to know, learn, realize
γινώσκω.d: I am taking in knowledge, come to know, learn; aor: I ascertained, realized.

Ἰουδαία.d: Judea, a Roman province, capital Jerusalem.

ἡμέρα.d: a day, the period from sunrise to sunset.

Ἡρῴδης.d: Herod; four persons are called by this name: Herod the Great, Herod Antipas, Herod Agrippa, and Herod Agrippa the younger.

μάγος.d: a sorcerer, a magician, a wizard.

ἀνατολή.g: rising of the sun, the East
ἀνατολή.d: (a) rising of the sun, hence (b) (sing. and plur.) the quarter whence the sun rises, the East.

παραγίνομαι.d: (a) I come on the scene, appear, come, (b) with words expressing destination: I present myself at, arrive at, reach.

εἰς.d: into, in, unto, to, upon, towards, for, among.

Ἱεροσόλυμα.d: the Greek form of the Hebrew name: Jerusalem.

ὁράω.d: I see, look upon, experience, perceive, discern, beware.

προσκυνέω.d: I go down on my knees to, do obeisance to, worship.

ἀκούω.d: I hear, listen, comprehend by hearing; pass: is heard, reported.

ταράσσω.d: I disturb, agitate, stir up, trouble.

συνάγω.d: I gather together, collect, assemble, receive with hospitality, entertain.

γραμματεύς.g: a scribe, town-clerk, man of learning
γραμματεύς.d: (a) in Jerusalem, a scribe, one learned in the Jewish Law, a religious teacher, (b) at Ephesus, the town-clerk, the secretary of the city, (c) a man of learning generally.

πυνθάνομαι.d: I ask, inquire, ascertain by inquiry, understand.

παρά.d: gen: from; dat: beside, in the presence of; acc: alongside of.

γράφω.d: I write; pass: it is written, it stands written (in the scriptures).

γῆ.d: the earth, soil, land, region, country, inhabitants of a region.

οὐδαμῶς.d: by no means, not at all.

ἐλάχιστος.d: least, smallest, but perhaps oftener in the weaker sense: very little, very small.

ἡγεμών.d: a leader, guide; a commander; a governor (of a province); plur: leaders.

ἡγέομαι.d: (a) I lead, (b) I think, am of opinion, suppose, consider.

ποιμαίνω.d: I shepherd, tend, herd; hence: I rule, govern.

Ἰσραήλ.d: (Hebrew), Israel, surname of Jacob, then the Jewish people, the people of God.

ἀκριβόω.d: I learn carefully, inquire with exactness.

πέμπω.d: I send, transmit, permit to go, put forth.

ἐξετάζω.d: I examine, question, inquire at, search out.

παιδίον.d: a little child, an infant, little one.

ἀπαγγέλλω.g: I report, bring a report, announce
ἀπαγγέλλω.d: I report (from one place to another), bring a report, announce, declare.

ὅπως.g: how, in order that, so that
ὅπως.d: how, in order that, so that, that.

κἀγώ.d: I also, I too, but I.

προάγω.d: (a) trans: I lead forth; in the judicial sense, into court, (b) intrans. and trans: I precede, go before, (c) intrans: I go too far.

ἵστημι.d: trans: (a) I make to stand, place, set up, establish, appoint; mid: I place myself, stand, (b) I set in balance, weigh; intrans: (c) I stand, stand by, stand still; met: I stand ready, stand firm, am steadfast.

ἐπάνω.g: on the top, above, superior to
ἐπάνω.d: (a) adv: on the top, above, (b) prep: on the top of, above, over, on, above, more than, superior to.

οὗ.d: where, whither, when, in what place.

χαίρω.d: I rejoice, am glad; also a salutation: Hail.

χαρά.d: joy, gladness, a source of joy.

μέγας.d: large, great, in the widest sense.

οἰκία.d: a house, household, dwelling; meton: goods, property, means.

πίπτω.d: I fall, fall under (as under condemnation), fall prostrate.

θησαυρός.d: a store-house for precious things; hence: a treasure, a store.

προσφέρω.d: (a) I bring to, (b) characteristically: I offer (of gifts, sacrifices, etc).

χρυσός.d: gold, anything made of gold, a gold coin.

χρηματίζω.d: (originally: I transact business), (a) act. of God: I warn; pass: I am warned by God (probably in response to an inquiry as to one's duty), (b) (I take a name from my public business, hence) I receive a name, am publicly called.

ἀνακάμπτω.d: I bend or turn back; I return.

ἄλλος.d: other, another (of more than two), different.

ἀναχωρέω.d: I return, retire, withdraw, depart (underlying idea perhaps of taking refuge from danger or of going into retirement).

χώρα.d: (a) a country or region, (b) the land, as opposed to the sea, (c) the country, distinct from town, (d) plur: fields.

ἐκεῖ.d: (a) there, yonder, in that place, (b) thither, there.

ἄν.g: an untranslatable word that makes a statement contingent
ἄν.d: an untranslatable word (under the circumstances, in that case, anyhow), the general effect of which is to make a statement contingent, which would otherwise be definite: it is thus regularly used with the subjunctive mood.

μέλλω.d: I intend, am about to; I delay, linger.

ζητέω.d: I seek, search for, desire, require, demand.

ἀπόλλυμι.d: (a) I kill, destroy, (b) I lose, mid: I am perishing (the resultant death being viewed as certain).

ὅτι.d: that, since, because; may introduce direct discourse.

θυμόομαι.g: I provoke to anger, am full of angry passion
θυμόομαι.d: I provoke to anger; pass: I am wroth or very angry.

ἀποστέλλω.g: I send forth, send, send away, dismiss
ἀποστέλλω.d: I send forth, send (as a messenger, commission, etc.), send away, dismiss.

ἀναιρέω.d: I take up, take away the life of, make an end of, murder.

παῖς.d: (a) a male child, boy, (b) a male slave, servant; thus: a servant of God, especially as a title of the Messiah, (c) a female child, girl.

ὅριον.d: the boundaries of a place, hence: districts, territory.

διετής.d: two years old, lasting two years.

φωνή.d: a sound, noise, voice, language, dialect.

Ῥαμά.d: Rama, a place in Ephraim, two hours north of Jerusalem.

πολύς.c: πολύς, πολλή, πολύ, gen. πολλοῦ, ῆς, οῦ

Ῥαχήλ.d: Rachel, younger wife of the patriarch Jacob.

κλαίω.d: I weep, weep for, mourn, lament.

παρακαλέω.d: (a) I send for, summon, invite, (b) I beseech, entreat, beg, (c) I exhort, admonish, (d) I comfort, encourage, console.

θνῄσκω.d: I die, am dying, am dead.

ψυχή.d: (a) the vital breath, breath of life, (b) the human soul, (c) the soul as the seat of affections and will, (d) the self, (e) a human person, an individual.

εἰσέρχομαι.g: I go in, come in, enter
εἰσέρχομαι.d: I go in, come in, enter.

Ἀρχέλαος.d: Archelaus, Herod Archelaus, son and successor of Herod I, reigned over Judea from 4 B.C. to A.D. 6 and died before A.D. 18.

βασιλεύω.d: (a) I rule, reign, (b) I reign over.

ἀντί.d: (a) instead of, in return for, over against, opposite, in exchange for, as a substitute for, (b) on my behalf, (c) wherefore, because.

ἀπέρχομαι.g: I come or go away from, depart, return
ἀπέρχομαι.d: I come or go away from, depart, return, arrive, go after, follow.

Γαλιλαία.d: Galilee, a district towards the southern end of the Roman province Syria; the northern division of Palestine.

κατοικέω.g: I dwell in, settle in, inhabit
κατοικέω.d: I dwell in, settle in, am established in (permanently), inhabit.

πόλις.d: a city, the inhabitants of a city.

Ναζαρέτ.d: Nazareth, a city of Galilee, where Jesus lived before His ministry.

Ναζωραῖος.d: a Nazarene, an inhabitant of Nazareth.

Ἰωάννης.d: John: the Baptist, the apostle, a member of the Sanhedrin, or John Mark.

βαπτιστής.d: the baptizer, the Baptist, epithet used only of John, the son of Zechariah and Elizabeth, forerunner of Jesus.

ἔρημος.d: as an adj: deserted, desolate, waste; hence: the desert, to the east and south of Palestine; of a person: deserted, abandoned, desolate.

μετανοέω.d: I repent, change my mind, change the inner man (particularly with reference to acceptance of the will of God), repent.

ἐγγίζω.d: trans: I bring near; intrans: I come near, approach.

βασιλεία.d: kingship, sovereignty, authority, rule, especially of God, both in the world, and in the hearts of men; hence: kingdom, in the concrete sense.

οὐρανός.d: heaven, (a) the visible heavens: the atmosphere, the sky, the starry heavens, (b) the spiritual heavens.

εὐθύς.d: adj: (a) straight of direction, as opposed to crooked, (b) upright; adv: immediately.

τρίβος.d: a worn path, beaten way, road, highway.

θρίξ.d: hair (of the head or of animals).

ζώνη.d: a girdle, belt, waistband; because the purse was kept there, also: a purse.

ἐκπορεύομαι.d: I depart from; I am voided, cast out; I proceed from, am spoken; I burst forth, flow out, am spread abroad.

περίχωρος.d: neighboring; subst: the neighboring country, neighboring inhabitants.

Ἰορδάνης.d: the Jordan, a great river flowing due south and bounding Galilee, Samaria, and Judea on the east.

βαπτίζω.d: lit: I dip, submerge, but specifically of ceremonial dipping; I baptize.

ἐξομολογέω.d: (a) I consent fully, agree out and out, (b) I confess, admit, acknowledge (cf. the early Hellenistic sense of the middle: I acknowledge a debt), (c) I give thanks, praise.

Φαρισαῖος.d: a Pharisee, one of the Jewish sect so called.

Σαδδουκαῖος.d: a Sadducee, a member of the aristocratic party among the Jews, from whom the high-priests were almost invariably chosen.

βάπτισμα.g: the rite or ceremony of baptism
βάπτισμα.d: the rite or ceremony of baptism.

ὑποδείκνυμι.d: I indicate, intimate, suggest, show, prove.

καρπός.d: (a) fruit, generally vegetable, sometimes animal, (b) met: fruit, deed, action, result, (c) profit, gain.

ἄξιος.d: worthy, worthy of, deserving, comparable, suitable.

μετάνοια.d: repentance, a change of mind, change in the inner man.

δοκέω.g: I think, seem, appear, it seems
δοκέω.d: I think, seem, appear, it seems.

δύναμαι.d: (a) I am powerful, have (the) power, (b) I am able, I can.

λίθος.d: a stone; met: of Jesus as the chief stone in a building.

ἤδη.d: already; now at length, now after all this waiting.

ῥίζα.g: a root, that which comes from the root
ῥίζα.d: a root, shoot, source; that which comes from the root, a descendent.

κεῖμαι.d: I lie, recline, am placed, am laid, set, specially appointed, destined.

καλός.d: beautiful, as an outward sign of the inward good, noble, honorable character; good, worthy, honorable, noble, and seen to be so.

ἐκκόπτω.d: I cut out (off, away), remove, prevent.

πῦρ.d: fire; the heat of the sun, lightning; fig: strife, trials; the eternal fire.

βάλλω.g: I cast, throw, rush, put, place, drop
βάλλω.d: (a) I cast, throw, rush, (b) often, in the weaker sense: I place, put, drop.

μέν.d: an untranslatable particle, generally answered by "de", each of the two introducing a clause intended to be contrasted with the other.

ἰσχυρός.d: strong (originally and generally of physical strength); mighty, powerful, vehement, sure.

ἱκανός.d: (a) considerable, sufficient, of number, quantity, time, (b) of persons: sufficiently strong (good, etc.), worthy, suitable, with various constructions, (c) many, much.

βαστάζω.d: (a) I carry, bear, (b) I carry (take) away.

πτύον.d: a simple wooden pitchfork; a winnowing-shovel or fan.

ἀποκρίνομαι.d: I answer, reply, take up the conversation.

ἀφίημι.g: I send away, release, remit, forgive, permit
ἀφίημι.d: (a) I send away, (b) I let go, release, permit to depart, (c) I remit, forgive, (d) I permit, suffer.

ἄρτι.d: now, just now, at this moment.

πρέπω.d: it becomes, is fitting to, is right.

δικαιοσύνη.d: (usually if not always in a Jewish atmosphere), justice, justness, righteousness, righteousness of which God is the source or author, but practically: a divine righteousness.

ἀναβαίνω.d: I go up, mount, ascend; of things: I rise, spring up, come up.

καταβαίνω.d: I go down, come down, either from the sky or from higher land, descend.

ὡσεί.g: as if, as it were, like, about
ὡσεί.d: as if, as it were, like; with numbers: about.

ἀγαπητός.d: loved, beloved, with two special applications: the Beloved, a title of the Messiah (Christ), as beloved beyond all others by the God who sent Him; of Christians, as beloved by God, Christ, and one another.

εὐδοκέω.d: I am well-pleased, think it good, am resolved.

ἀνάγω.g: I lead up, put to sea, set sail
ἀνάγω.d: I lead up, bring up, offer, produce, put to sea, set sail.

διάβολος.d: (adj. used often as a noun), slanderous; with the article: the Slanderer (par excellence), the Devil.

πεινάω.d: I am hungry, needy, desire earnestly.

προσέρχομαι.d: I come up to, come to, come near (to), approach, consent (to).

ἄνθρωπος.g: a man, one of the human race
ἄνθρωπος.d: a man, one of the human race.

ῥῆμα.d: a thing spoken, (a) a word or saying of any kind, as command, report, promise, (b) a thing, matter, business.

στόμα.d: the mouth, speech, eloquence in speech, the point of a sword.

κάτω.d: (a) down, below, also: downwards, (b) lower, under, less, of a length of time.

αἴρω.d: I raise, lift up, take away, remove.

μήποτε.g: lest at any time, lest, perhaps
μήποτε.d: lest at any time, lest; then weakened: whether perhaps, whether at all; in a principal clause: perhaps.

προσκόπτω.d: I stumble, strike the foot against, beat upon, take offense at.

πάλιν.g: again, further, on the other hand
πάλιν.d: again, back, once more, further, on the other hand.

ἐκπειράζω.g: I put to the test, make trial of, tempt
ἐκπειράζω.d: I put to the test, make trial of, tempt, try.

δείκνυμι.d: I point out, show, exhibit; met: I teach, demonstrate, make known.

κόσμος.d: the world, universe; worldly affairs; the inhabitants of the world; adornment.

δόξα.d: honor, renown; glory, an especially divine quality, the unspoken manifestation of God, splendor.

δίδωμι.d: I offer, give; I put, place.

ὑπάγω.d: I go away, depart, begone, die.

λατρεύω.d: I serve, especially God, perhaps simply: I worship.

διακονέω.d: I wait at table (particularly of a slave who waits on guests); I serve (generally).

παραδίδωμι.d: I hand over, pledge, hand down, deliver, commit, commend, betray, abandon.

καταλείπω.d: I leave behind, desert, abandon, forsake; I leave remaining, reserve.

Ζαβουλών.d: Zebulon, one of the sons of Jacob, and founder of one of the twelve tribes.

Νεφθαλίμ.d: Naphtali, son of Jacob, founder of a tribe which occupied territory.

θάλασσα.d: (a) the sea, in contrast to the land, (b) a particular sea or lake, e.g. the sea of Galilee (Tiberias), the Red Sea.

πέραν.d: over, on the other side, beyond.

ἔθνος.d: a race, people, nation; the nations, heathen world, Gentiles.

κάθημαι.d: I sit, am seated, enthroned; I dwell, reside.

φῶς.d: light, a source of light, radiance.

σκιά.g: a shadow, thick darkness, an outline
σκιά.d: a shadow, shade, thick darkness, an outline.

ἀνατέλλω.g: I make to rise, I rise, shine
ἀνατέλλω.d: I make to rise, I rise, shine (generally of the sun, and hence met.).

περιπατέω.d: I walk, hence Hebraistically (in an ethical sense): I conduct my life, live.

Ἀνδρέας.d: Andrew, brother of Simon Peter, and one of the apostles of Jesus, belonging to Bethsaida.

ἀμφίβληστρον.d: prop: something thrown around; a fishing-net, drag-net.

δεῦτε.d: come hither, come, hither, an exclamatory word.

Ἰάκωβος.d: James, (a) the Small, son of Alphaeus, and one of the Twelve, (b) half-brother of Jesus, (c) father (?) of Jude, (d) son of Zebedee, and brother of John, one of the Twelve, killed A.D. 44.

Ζεβεδαῖος.d: Zebedee, father of the apostles James and John.

καταρτίζω.d: (a) I fit (join) together; met: I compact together, (b) act. and mid: I prepare, perfect, for his (its) full destination or use, bring into its proper condition (whether for the first time, or after a lapse).

περιάγω.d: I lead or carry about (or around), go about, traverse.

συναγωγή.d: an assembly, congregation, synagogue, either the place or the people gathered together in the place.

εὐαγγέλιον.d: the good news of the coming of the Messiah, the gospel; the gen. after it expresses sometimes the giver (God), sometimes the subject (the Messiah, etc.), sometimes the human transmitter (an apostle).

θεραπεύω.g: I care for, attend, serve, heal
θεραπεύω.d: I care for, attend, serve, treat, especially of a physician; hence: I heal.

ἀκοή.d: hearing, faculty of hearing, ear; report, rumor.

Συρία.d: Syria, a great Roman imperial province, united with Cilicia.

ποικίλος.d: various, of different colors, diverse, various.

συνέχω.g: I press together, confine, compel, am afflicted with
συνέχω.d: (a) I press together, close, (b) I press on every side, confine, (c) I hold fast, (d) I urge, impel, (e) pass: I am afflicted with (sickness).

δαιμονίζομαι.d: I am possessed, am under the power of an evil-spirit or demon.

σεληνιάζομαι.d: I am a lunatic, am moonstruck, epileptic.

ὄχλος.d: a crowd, mob, the common people.

Δεκάπολις.d: Decapolis, meaning a group or district of ten cities (of the Greek type) in Palestine, mostly south-east of the Lake of Tiberias; the names and number vary in ancient authorities.

καθίζω.d: (a) trans: I make to sit; I set, appoint, (b) intrans: I sit down, am seated, stay.

πτωχός.d: poor, destitute, spiritually poor, either in a good sense (humble devout persons) or bad.

κληρονομέω.d: I inherit, obtain (possess) by inheritance, acquire.

καθαρός.d: clean, pure, unstained, either literally or ceremonially or spiritually; guiltless, innocent, upright.

καρδία.d: lit: the heart; mind, character, inner self, will, intention, center.

ἕνεκεν.g: for the sake of, on account of, wherefore
ἕνεκεν.d: for the sake of, on account of, on account of which, wherefore, on account of what, why.

ἀγαλλιάω.g: I exult, am full of joy
ἀγαλλιάω.d: I exult, am full of joy.

μισθός.d: (a) pay, wages, salary, (b) reward, recompense, punishment.

πρό.d: (a) of place: before, in front of, (b) of time: before, earlier than.

μωραίνω.g: I make foolish, taint, make useless
μωραίνω.d: (a) I make foolish, turn to foolishness, (b) I taint, and thus: I am tasteless, make useless.

ἁλίζω.g: I salt, sprinkle with salt, keep fresh and sound
ἁλίζω.d: I salt, sprinkle with salt (of sacrifices or of those who offer sacrifice), keep fresh and sound, and so acceptable to God.

ἰσχύω.d: I have strength, am strong, am in full health and vigor, am able; meton: I prevail.

ἔτι.d: (a) of time: still, yet, even now, (b) of degree: even, further, more, in addition.

καταπατέω.d: I trample down, trample under foot (lit. and met.), spurn.

οὐδέ.d: neither, nor, not even, and not.

καίω.d: I ignite, light, burn, lit. and met; I consume with fire.

τίθημι.d: I put, place, lay, set, fix, establish.

μόδιος.g: a dry measure, nearly two English gallons
μόδιος.d: a dry measure, nearly two English gallons.

ἔμπροσθεν.d: in front, before the face; sometimes made a subst. by the addition of the article: in front of, before the face of.

ἔργον.d: work, task, employment; a deed, action; that which is wrought or made, a work.

δοξάζω.g: I glorify, honor, bestow glory on
δοξάζω.d: I glorify, honor, bestow glory on.

νομίζω.d: I practice, hold by custom; I deem, think, consider, suppose.

καταλύω.g: I break up, overthrow, unharness, find a lodging
καταλύω.d: (lit: I loosen thoroughly), (a) trans: I break up, overthrow, destroy, both lit. and met., (b) I unyoke, unharness a carriage horse or pack animal; hence: I put up, lodge, find a lodging.

νόμος.d: usage, custom, law; in NT: of law in general, plur: of divine laws; of a force or influence impelling to action; of the Mosaic law; meton: of the books which contain the law, the Pentateuch, the Old Testament scriptures in general.

ἀμήν.g: verily, truly, amen, so let it be
ἀμήν.d: verily, truly, amen; at the end of sentences may be paraphrased by: So let it be.

παρέρχομαι.d: I pass by, pass away, pass out of sight; I am rendered void, become vain, neglect, disregard.

ἰῶτα.g: a small letter of the Greek alphabet
ἰῶτα.d: iota, a small letter of the Greek alphabet, used in the NT (like yod, the Hebrew or rather Aramaic letter which was the smallest of all) to indicate the smallest part.

εἷς.c: εἷς, μία, ἕν, gen. ἑνός, μιᾶς, ἑνός

κεραία.d: a little hook, an apostrophe on letters of the alphabet, distinguishing them from other little letters, or a separation stroke between letters.

λύω.d: (a) I loose, untie, release, (b) met: I break, destroy, set at naught, contravene; I break up a meeting, annul.

περισσεύω.d: (a) intrans: I exceed the ordinary (the necessary), abound, overflow; am left over, (b) trans: I cause to abound.

ἔνοχος.d: involved in, held in, hence: liable, generally with dat. (or gen.) of the punishment.

κρίσις.d: judging, judgment, decision, sentence; generally: divine judgment; accusation.

συνέδριον.d: a council, tribunal; the Sanhedrin, the meeting place of the Sanhedrin.

μωρός.d: (a) adj: stupid, foolish, (b) noun: a fool.

γέεννα.d: Gehenna, and originally the name of a valley or cavity near Jerusalem, a place underneath the earth, a place of punishment for evil.

κἀκεῖ.d: and there, and yonder, there also.

μιμνῄσκομαι.d: I remember, call to mind, recall, mention.

τις.d: any one, some one, a certain one or thing.

διαλλάσσομαι.g: I become reconciled to, reconcile myself with
διαλλάσσομαι.d: I change, exchange; I reconcile, change enmity for friendship.

ὑπηρέτης.d: a servant, an attendant, (a) an officer, lictor, (b) an attendant in a synagogue, (c) a minister of the gospel.

φυλακή.d: a watching, keeping guard; a guard, prison; imprisonment.

ἀποδίδωμι.d: (a) I give back, return, restore, (b) I give, render, as due, (c) mid: I sell.

ἔσχατος.d: last, at the last, finally, till the end.

κοδράντης.d: a "quadrans," the smallest Roman copper coin, a quarter of an "as," the sixteenth part of a "sesterius".

μοιχεύω.d: I commit adultery (of a man with a married woman, but also of a married man).

βλέπω.d: (primarily physical), I look, see, perceive, discern.

ἐπιθυμέω.g: I long for, covet, lust after
ἐπιθυμέω.d: I long for, covet, lust after, set the heart upon.

ὀφθαλμός.d: the eye; fig: the mind's eye.

δεξιός.g: on the right hand, right hand, right
δεξιός.d: on the right hand, right hand, right.

σκανδαλίζω.d: I cause to stumble, cause to sin, cause to become indignant, shock, offend.

ἐξαιρέω.d: I take out, remove; sometimes (mid): I choose, sometimes: I rescue.

συμφέρω.d: I bring together, collect; I am profitable to.

σῶμα.d: body, flesh; the body of the Church.

ἀποστάσιον.d: repudiation, divorce; met: bill of divorce.

παρεκτός.d: (a) adv. used as adj: besides, outside, without, left over, in addition, (b) prep: apart from, except.

λόγος.g: a word, speech, divine utterance, analogy
λόγος.d: a word, speech, divine utterance, analogy.

γαμέω.d: I marry, used of either sex.

μοιχάομαι.d: I commit adultery, not only of a married woman but of a married man.

ἐπιορκέω.g: I take an oath, swear falsely
ἐπιορκέω.d: I take an oath, swear falsely.

ὀμνύω.d: I swear, take an oath, promise with an oath.

ὅλως.d: wholly, altogether, actually, really; with negative: not at all.

θρόνος.d: a (king's) throne, seat; meton: power, dominion; a potentate.

κεφαλή.d: (a) the head, (b) met: a corner stone, uniting two walls; head, ruler, lord.

μέλας.c: μέλας, μέλαινα, μέλαν, gen. ανος, αίνης, ανος

περισσός.d: more, greater, excessive, abundant, exceedingly, vehemently; noun: preeminence, advantage.

ἀνθίστημι.g: I take a stand against, oppose, resist
ἀνθίστημι.d: I set against; I withstand, resist, oppose.

ῥαπίζω.d: I slap, strike, smite with the hand.

στρέφω.d: I turn, am converted, change, change my direction.

κρίνω.d: (a) I judge, whether in a law-court or privately: sometimes with cognate nouns emphasizing the notion of the verb, (b) I decide, I think (it) good.

λαμβάνω.d: (a) I receive, get, (b) I take, lay hold of.

ἱμάτιον.d: a long flowing outer garment, tunic.

ἀγγαρεύω.d: I impress (into my service), send (on an errand).

μίλιον.d: a Roman mile, measuring 1478.5 meters or 5820.9 feet.

ἀποστρέφω.d: I turn away, pervert, remove; I restore, replace; mid: I desert, reject.

ἀγαπάω.d: I love, wish well to, take pleasure in, long for; denotes the love of reason, esteem.

μισέω.d: I hate, detest, love less, esteem less.

προσεύχομαι.d: I pray, pray for, offer prayer.

ὑπέρ.d: gen: in behalf of; acc: above.

ἀγαθός.d: intrinsically good, good in nature, good whether it be seen to be so or not, the widest and most colorless of all words with this meaning.

οὐχί.g: by no means, not at all
οὐχί.d: by no means, not at all.

ἀσπάζομαι.g: I greet, salute, pay my respects to
ἀσπάζομαι.d: I greet, salute, pay my respects to, welcome.

ἐθνικός.g: pagan, heathen, gentile; a Gentile, non-Jew
ἐθνικός.d: pagan, heathen, gentile; subst: a Gentile, non-Jew.

τέλειος.d: perfect, (a) complete in all its parts, (b) full grown, of full age, (c) specially of the completeness of Christian character.

οὐράνιος.d: in heaven, belonging to heaven, heavenly, from heaven.

προσέχω.g: I pay attention to, devote myself to
προσέχω.d: (a) I attend to, pay attention to, (b) I beware, am cautious, (c) I join, devote myself to.

θεάομαι.d: I see, behold, contemplate, look upon, view; I see, visit.

γέ.d: an enclitic, emphasizing particle: at least, indeed, really, but generally too subtle to be represented in English.

ἐλεημοσύνη.d: abstr: alms-giving, charity; concr: alms, charity.

ὑποκριτής.d: (lit: a stage-player), a hypocrite, dissembler, pretender.

ῥύμη.d: a narrow street or lane in a town or city.

ἀπέχω.g: I have in full, am far, it is enough
ἀπέχω.d: I have in full, am far, it is enough.

κρυπτός.d: hidden, secret; as subst: the hidden (secret) things (parts), the inward nature (character).

φιλέω.d: I love (of friendship), regard with affection, cherish; I kiss.

γωνία.d: a corner; met: a secret place.

ταμεῖον.d: a store-chamber, secret chamber, closet; a granary, barn.

βατταλογέω.d: I chatter, am long-winded, utter empty words, stammer, repeat.

ὁμοιόω.d: I make like, liken; I compare.

ἁγιάζω.d: I make holy, treat as holy, set apart as holy, sanctify, hallow, purify.

θέλημα.d: an act of will, will; plur: wishes, desires.

ὀφειλέτης.d: (a) a debtor, one who owes, one who is indebted, (b) one who has sinned against another (an Aramaism), a sinner.

εἰσφέρω.d: I lead into, bring in, announce.

πειρασμός.d: (a) trial, probation, testing, being tried, (b) temptation, (c) calamity, affliction.

ῥύομαι.d: I rescue, deliver (from danger or destruction).

παράπτωμα.d: a falling away, lapse, slip, false step, trespass, sin.

ἀφανίζω.g: I cause to disappear, I hide, remove, disfigure
ἀφανίζω.d: I cause to disappear, hide, remove; I disfigure (probably by leaving unwashed for a long period), destroy.

ἀλείφω.d: I anoint: festivally, in homage, medicinally, or in anointing the dead.

νίπτω.d: I wash; mid. I wash my own (hands, etc.).

θησαυρίζω.g: I store up, treasure up, save
θησαυρίζω.d: I store up, treasure up, save, lay up.

βρῶσις.d: (a) abstr: eating, (b) food, a meal, (c) rust.

πόσος.g: how much, how great, how many
πόσος.d: how much, how great, how many.

δουλεύω.g: I am a slave, am subject to, obey
δουλεύω.d: I am a slave, am subject to, obey, am devoted.

ἕτερος.d: (a) of two: another, a second, (b) other, different, (c) one's neighbor.

ἀντέχομαι.d: trans: I hold against; intrans: I withstand; mid: I hold out against, hold firmly to, cleave to.

καταφρονέω.d: I despise, scorn, and show it by active insult, disregard.

μεριμνάω.d: I am over-anxious; with acc: I am anxious about, distracted; I care for.

ἐσθίω.d: I eat, partake of food; met: I devour, consume (e.g. as rust does).

ἐμβλέπω.d: I look into (upon); met: I consider; I see clearly.

τρέφω.d: I feed, nourish; I bring up, rear, provide for.

διαφέρω.g: I carry through, differ, surpass, excel
διαφέρω.d: (a) trans: I carry through, hither and thither, (b) intrans: I am different, differ, and sometimes: I surpass, excel.

προστίθημι.g: I put to, add, do again
προστίθημι.d: I place (put) to, add; I do again.

ἡλικία.d: age, term of life; full age, maturity; stature.

πῆχυς.d: a cubit, about a foot and a half.

καταμανθάνω.d: I understand, take in a fact about, consider carefully.

κρίνον.d: a lily growing wild, variously identified with the red anemone, the whole lily, the sword lily.

ἀγρός.d: a field, especially as bearing a crop; the country, lands, property in land, a country estate.

πῶς.d: how, in what manner, by what means.

αὐξάνω.g: I cause to increase, become greater, grow
αὐξάνω.d: (a) I cause to increase, become greater (b) I increase, grow.

κοπιάω.d: (a) I grow weary, (b) I toil, work with effort (of bodily and mental labor alike).

περιβάλλω.d: I cast around, wrap a garment about, put on; hence mid: I put on to myself, clothe myself, dress; I draw (a line).

ἐπιζητέω.g: I seek after, desire, search for
ἐπιζητέω.d: I seek after, desire, search for, make inquiries about.

χρῄζω.d: I need, have need of, want, desire.

κακία.d: (a) evil (i.e. trouble, labor, misfortune), (b) wickedness, (c) vicious disposition, malice, spite.

κρίμα.d: (a) a judgment, a verdict; sometimes implying an adverse verdict, a condemnation, (b) a case at law, a lawsuit.

μέτρον.d: a measure, whether lineal or cubic; a measuring rod.

κάρφος.g: a dry stalk, chip of wood
κάρφος.d: a dry stalk, chip of wood, twig, splinter, chaff.

δοκός.d: a beam or spar of timber.

κατανοέω.d: I take note of, perceive, consider carefully, discern, detect, make account of.

ἐκβάλλω.g: I throw, cast, put out, banish, bring forth, produce
ἐκβάλλω.d: I throw (cast, put) out; I banish; I bring forth, produce.

κύων.d: a dog, universally despised in the East.

ῥήγνυμι.d: I rend, break asunder; I break forth (into speech); I throw or dash down.

κρούω.d: I knock, beat a door with a stick, to gain admittance.

ἐπιδίδωμι.g: I hand in, give up, give way
ἐπιδίδωμι.d: (a) trans: I hand in, give up, (b) intrans: I give way (to the wind).

ὄφις.d: a serpent, snake; used of the devil or Satan.

ὅσος.g: how much, how great, how many
ὅσος.d: how much, how great, how many, as great as, as much.

πλατεῖα.d: a street, public square, broad way.

ἀπάγω.d: I lead, carry, take away; met: I am led astray, seduced.

ἀπώλεια.d: destruction, ruin, loss, perishing; eternal ruin.

θλίβω.g: I make narrow, persecute, press hard
θλίβω.d: (a) I make narrow (strictly: by pressure); I press upon, (b) I persecute, press hard.

ζωή.d: life, both of physical (present) and of spiritual (particularly future) existence.

ὀλίγος.d: (a) especially in plur: few, (b) in sing: small; hence, of time: short, of degree: light, slight, little.

ψευδοπροφήτης.d: a false prophet; one who in God's name teaches what is false.

ἔσωθεν.d: (a) from within, from inside, (b) within, inside; with the article: the inner part, the inner element, (c) the mind, soul.

λύκος.d: a wolf, of perhaps a jackal; often applied to persons of wolfish proclivities.

ἅρπαξ.g: rapacious, ravenous, a robber, an extortioner
ἅρπαξ.d: rapacious, ravenous; a robber, an extortioner.

ἐπιγινώσκω.g: I come to know, discern, recognize
ἐπιγινώσκω.d: I come to know by directing my attention to him or it, I perceive, discern, recognize; aor: I found out.

μήτι.d: if not, unless, whether at all.

ἄκανθα.d: a thorn-bush, prickly plant; a thorn.

προφητεύω.d: I foretell, prophesy; I set forth matter of divine teaching by special faculty.

δαιμόνιον.d: an evil-spirit, demon; a heathen deity.

δύναμις.d: (a) physical power, force, might, ability, efficacy, energy, meaning (b) plur: powerful deeds, deeds showing (physical) power, marvelous works.

ὁμολογέω.d: (a) I promise, agree, (b) I confess, (c) I publicly declare, (d) a Hebraism, I praise, celebrate.

ἐργάζομαι.d: I work, trade, perform, do, practice, commit, acquire by labor.

οἰκοδομέω.d: I erect a building, build; fig. of the building up of character: I build up, edify, encourage.

πέτρα.d: a rock, ledge, cliff, cave, stony ground.

πνέω.d: I blow, breathe, as the wind.

ἄνεμος.d: the wind; fig: applied to empty doctrines.

προσπίπτω.g: I fall down before, beat against
προσπίπτω.d: (a) I fall down before, (b) I beat against, rush violently upon.

θεμελιόω.d: I found, lay the foundation (lit. and met.).

τελέω.d: (a) I end, finish, (b) I fulfill, accomplish, (c) I pay.

ἐκπλήσσομαι.d: I strike with panic or shock; I amaze, astonish.

ἐξουσία.d: (a) power, authority, weight, especially: moral authority, influence, (b) in a quasi-personal sense, derived from later Judaism, of a spiritual power, and hence of an earthly power.

καθαρίζω.d: I cleanse, make clean, literally, ceremonially, or spiritually, according to context.

ἐκτείνω.d: I stretch out (forth), cast forth (as of an anchor), lay hands on.

ἱερεύς.d: a priest, one who offers sacrifice to a god (in Jewish and pagan religions; of Christians only met.).

βασανίζω.d: I examine, as by torture; I torment; I buffet, as of waves.

στέγη.g: a flat roof of a house
στέγη.d: a flat roof of a house.

ἰάομαι.d: I heal, generally of the physical, sometimes of spiritual, disease.

θαυμάζω.d: (a) intrans: I wonder, marvel, (b) trans: I wonder at, admire.

τοσοῦτος.d: so great, so large, so long, so many.

πίστις.d: faith, belief, trust, confidence; fidelity, faithfulness.

δυσμή.g: a setting of the sun, the West
δυσμή.d: a setting (of the sun), hence: the West.

ἥκω.d: I have come, am present, have arrived.

ἀνακλίνω.g: I make to recline, I recline at a table
ἀνακλίνω.d: I lay upon, lean against, lay down, make to recline; pass: I lie back, recline.

ἑκατοντάρχης.d: a centurion of the Roman army.

πιστεύω.d: I believe, have faith in, trust in; pass: I am entrusted with.

ὥρα.d: (a) a definite space of time, a season, (b) an hour, (c) the particular time for anything.

πυρέσσω.g: I am sick with a fever
πυρέσσω.d: I am sick with a fever.

ἀσθένεια.d: want of strength, weakness, illness, suffering, calamity, frailty.

ἀλώπηξ.d: a fox; a fox-like, crafty person.

κλίνω.g: I rest, recline, make to yield
κλίνω.d: trans: I rest, recline; I bend, incline; I cause to give ground, make to yield; intrans: I decline, approach my end.

ἐπιτρέπω.d: I turn to, commit, entrust; I allow, yield, permit.

νεκρός.d: (a) adj: dead, lifeless, subject to death, mortal, (b) noun: a dead body, a corpse.

ἐμβαίνω.d: I step in; I go onboard a ship, embark.

σεισμός.d: a shaking (as an earthquake); a storm.

ὥστε.d: so that, therefore, so then, so as to.

ἐπιτιμάω.d: (a) I rebuke, chide, admonish, (b) I warn.

ποταπός.d: of what kind, of what manner.

ὑπακούω.d: I listen, hearken to, obey, answer.

Γαδαρηνός.d: Gadarene, belonging to Gadara (an important Hellenized town, one of the Decapolis, and south-east of the Sea of Galilee).

ὧδε.d: here, the things here, what is here, what is going on here, the state of affairs here.

καιρός.d: fitting season, season, opportunity, occasion, time.

μακρός.d: long, distant, far; of long duration.

ἀποθνῄσκω.g: I am dying, am about to die
ἀποθνῄσκω.d: I am dying, am about to die, wither, decay.

μεταβαίνω.g: I leave, depart, remove, pass over
μεταβαίνω.d: I change my place (abode), leave, depart, remove, pass over.

ἴδιος.d: one's own, belonging to one, private, personal; one's own people, one's own family, home, property.

κλίνη.d: a couch, bed, portable bed or mat, a couch for reclining at meals, possibly also a bier.

θαρσέω.d: I am of good courage, good cheer, am bold.

βλασφημέω.d: I speak evil against, blaspheme, use abusive or scurrilous language about (God or men).

οἶκος.d: (a) a house, the material building, (b) a household, family, lineage, nation.

παράγω.g: I pass by, depart, pass away
παράγω.d: I pass by, depart, pass away.

ἀνίστημι.g: I raise up, set up, rise from
ἀνίστημι.d: I raise up, set up; I rise from among (the) dead; I arise, appear.

ἀνάκειμαι.g: I recline, especially at a dinner-table
ἀνάκειμαι.d: I recline, especially at a dinner-table.

μανθάνω.d: I learn; with adj. or nouns: I learn to be so and so; with acc. of person who is the object of knowledge; aor. sometimes: to ascertain.

θυσία.d: abstr. and concr: sacrifice; a sacrifice, offering.

ἀπαίρω.d: I take away, remove; pass: I am taken away, withdrawn.

ἐπιβάλλω.g: I throw upon, lay, strike upon
ἐπιβάλλω.d: (a) I throw upon, cast over, (b) I place upon, (c) I lay, (d) intrans: I strike upon, rush.

ῥάκος.d: a piece of cloth, a remnant torn off.

παλαιός.d: old, ancient, not new or recent.

πλήρωμα.d: (a) a fill, fullness; full complement; supply, patch, supplement, (b) fullness, filling, fulfillment, completion.

σχίσμα.d: a rent, as in a garment; a division, dissention.

ἐκχέω.d: I pour out (liquid or solid); I shed, bestow liberally.

συντηρέω.g: I preserve, keep safe, keep in mind
συντηρέω.d: I preserve, keep safe, keep in mind, keep close.

λαλέω.d: (I talk, chatter in classical Greek, but in NT a more dignified word) I speak, say.

ἄρχων.d: a ruler, governor, leader, leading man; with the Jews, an official member (a member of the executive) of the assembly of elders.

θυγάτηρ.d: a daughter; hence (Hebraistic?), of any female descendent, however far removed; even of one unrelated: my young lady.

ἐπιτίθημι.g: I put, place upon, lay on
ἐπιτίθημι.d: I put, place upon, lay on; I add, give in addition.

αἱμορροέω.g: I suffer from a continual flow (oozing) of blood
αἱμορροέω.d: I suffer from a continual flow (oozing) of blood.

δώδεκα.d: twelve; the usual way in which the Twelve apostles of Jesus are referred to.

θορυβέω.g: I disturb greatly, terrify, strike with panic
θορυβέω.d: I disturb greatly, terrify, strike with panic; mid: I show agitation of mind.

κοράσιον.d: a little girl, a young girl; a girl, maiden.

κρατέω.d: I am strong, mighty, hence: I rule, am master, prevail; I obtain, take hold of; I hold, hold fast.

ἐμβριμάομαι.d: I snort (with the notion of coercion springing out of displeasure, anger, indignation, antagonism), express indignant displeasure with some one; I charge sternly.

σπλαγχνίζομαι.d: I feel compassion, have pity on, am moved.

ῥίπτω.d: I throw, cast, toss, set down; pass: I am dispersed.

ποιμήν.d: a shepherd; hence met: of the feeder, protector, and ruler of a flock of men.

θερισμός.d: reaping, harvest; met: the harvest, crop.

ἐργάτης.d: a field-laborer; then: a laborer, workman in general.

δέω.d: I bind, tie, fasten; I impel, compel; I declare to be prohibited and unlawful.

ἀπόστολος.g: an apostle, a messenger, an envoy, a delegate
ἀπόστολος.d: a messenger, envoy, delegate, one commissioned by another to represent him in some way, especially a man sent out by Jesus Christ Himself to preach the Gospel; an apostle.

Φίλιππος.d: Philip, (a) one of the twelve apostles of Jesus, (b) tetrarch of the Ituraean and Trachonitic region, half-brother of Herod Antipas, tetrarch of Galilee, (c) one of the seven original deacons at Jerusalem and a missionary.

Βαρθολομαῖος.d: Bartholomew, surname of Nathanael, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus.

Θωμᾶς.d: Thomas, also called Didymus, one of the Twelve.

Ἁλφαῖος.d: Alphaeus; apparently two persons, (a) father of Levi, and (b) father of James.

Θαδδαῖος.d: Thaddaeus, one of the twelve apostles.

παραγγέλλω.d: I notify, command, charge, entreat solemnly.

ἀσθενέω.d: I am weak (physically: then morally), I am sick.

δωρεάν.g: as a free gift, without payment, freely
δωρεάν.d: as a free gift, without payment, freely.

κτάομαι.d: (a) I acquire, win, get, purchase, buy, (b) I possess, win mastery over.

χαλκός.d: copper, brass, money; a brazen musical instrument.

πήρα.d: a sack, wallet for carrying provisions.

ῥάβδος.d: a rod, staff, staff of authority, scepter.

μένω.d: I remain, abide, stay, wait; with acc: I wait for, await.

εἰρήνη.d: peace, peace of mind; invocation of peace a common Jewish farewell, in the Hebraistic sense of the health (welfare) of an individual.

ἐπιστρέφω.d: (a) trans: I turn (back) to (towards), (b) intrans: I turn (back) (to [towards]); I come to myself.

ἐκτινάσσω.d: I shake off; mid: I shake off from myself.

Γόμορρα.c: Γόμορρα, ων, τά / Γόμορρα, ας, ἡ
Γόμορρα.d: Gomorrah, one of the destroyed cities on the Dead Sea.

μέσος.d: middle, in the middle, between, in the midst of.

μαστιγόω.d: I flog, scourge, the victim being strapped to a pole or frame; met: I chastise.

ἄγω.d: I lead, lead away, bring (a person, or animal), guide, spend a day, go.

ἐπανίσταμαι.d: intrans. tenses: I rise up against.

θανατόω.d: I put to death, subdue; pass: I am in danger of death, am dead to, am rid of, am parted from.

ὑπομένω.d: (a) I remain behind, (b) I stand my ground, show endurance, (c) I endure, bear up against, persevere.

τέλος.d: (a) an end, (b) event or issue, (c) the principal end, aim, purpose, (d) a tax.

Βεελζεβούλ.d: Beelzebul, a name of Satan, the chief of evil spirits.

ἐπικαλέω.g: I call by an additional name, appeal to
ἐπικαλέω.d: (a) I call (name) by a supplementary (additional, alternative) name, (b) mid: I call upon, appeal to, address.

οἰκιακός.d: one of a family, whether child or servant.

ἀποκαλύπτω.g: I uncover, bring to light, reveal
ἀποκαλύπτω.d: I uncover, bring to light, reveal.

οὖς.d: (a) the ear, (b) met: the faculty of perception.

δῶμα.d: the roof (of a house), the top of the house.

ἀποκτείνω.d: I put to death, kill; fig: I abolish.

ἀσσάριον.d: a small coin equal to the tenth part of a drachma.

ἄνευ.g: without, without the cooperation or knowledge of
ἄνευ.d: without, without the cooperation (or knowledge) of.

ἀρνέομαι.d: (a) I deny (a statement), (b) I repudiate (a person, or belief).

διχάζω.g: I set at variance, make to be hostile
διχάζω.d: I cut asunder; met: I set at variance, make to be hostile.

νύμφη.d: (a) a bride, young wife, young woman, (b) a daughter-in-law.

ποτίζω.g: I cause to drink, give to drink
ποτίζω.d: I cause to drink, give to drink; irrigate, water.

ποτήριον.d: a drinking cup, the contents of the cup; fig: the portion which God allots.

διατάσσω.d: I give orders to, prescribe, arrange.

προσδοκάω.d: I expect, wait for, await, think, anticipate.

ἀναβλέπω.g: I look up, recover my sight
ἀναβλέπω.d: I look up, recover my sight.

χωλός.d: lame, deprived of a foot, limping.

εὐαγγελίζω.g: I bring good news, preach good tidings
εὐαγγελίζω.d: I bring good news, preach good tidings, with or without an object, expressing either the persons who receive the good news or the good news itself (the good news being sometimes expressed as a person).

κάλαμος.d: a reed; a reed-pen, reed-staff, measuring rod.

σαλεύω.d: I shake, excite, disturb in mind, stir up, drive away.

μαλακός.d: (a) soft, (b) of persons: soft, delicate, effeminate.

περισσότερος.d: greater, more, even more, more abundantly.

κατασκευάζω.d: I build, construct, prepare, make ready.

βιάζω.g: I use force, violence, suffer violence
βιάζω.d: (a) mid: I use force, force my way, come forward violently, (b) pass: I am forcibly treated, suffer violence.

βιαστής.d: a forceful, violent man; one who is eager in pursuit.

ἁρπάζω.g: I seize, snatch, obtain by robbery
ἁρπάζω.d: I seize, snatch, obtain by robbery.

ὅμοιος.d: like, similar to, resembling, of equal rank.

ἀγορά.d: market-place, forum, public place of assembly.

προσφωνέω.d: I call to, summon; I call (out) to, address, give a speech to, harangue.

θρηνέω.d: intrans: I lament, wail; trans: I bewail.

κόπτω.d: (a) I cut, cut off, strike, smite, (b) mid: I beat my breast or head in lamentation, lament, mourn, sometimes with acc. of person whose loss is mourned.

φίλος.d: friendly; subst: a friend, an associate.

δικαιόω.g: I make righteous, defend the cause of, justify
δικαιόω.d: I make righteous, defend the cause of, plead for the righteousness (innocence) of, acquit, justify; hence: I regard as righteous.

σοφία.d: wisdom, insight, skill (human or divine), intelligence.

οὐαί.d: woe!, alas!, uttered in grief or denunciation.

Βηθσαϊδά.d: Bethsaida, (a) a city of Galilee, (b) a city east of the Jordan.

Τύρος.d: Tyre, an ancient city, the capital of Phoenicia.

Σιδών.d: Sidon, a great coast city of Phoenicia.

πάλαι.d: of old, long ago, in times past, former.

πλήν.d: however, nevertheless, but, except that, yet.

ὑψόω.d: (a) I raise on high, lift up, (b) I exalt, set on high.

μέχρι(ς).d: as far as, until, even to.

νήπιος.d: unlearned, unenlightened; noun: an infant, child.

εὐδοκία.d: (a) good-will (good-pleasure), favor, feeling of complacency of God to man, (b) good-pleasure, satisfaction, happiness, delight of men.

φορτίζω.d: I load, burden; pass: I am laden.

ἀναπαύω.g: I make to rest, give rest to, rest, take my ease
ἀναπαύω.d: I make to rest, give rest to; mid. and pass: I rest, take my ease.

ζυγός.g: a yoke, heavy burden, pair of scales
ζυγός.d: a yoke; hence met: (a Jewish idea) of a heavy burden, comparable to the heavy yokes resting on the bullocks' necks; a balance, pair of scales.

ταπεινός.d: humble, lowly, in position or spirit (in a good sense).

φορτίον.d: a burden; the freight of a ship.

ἀναγινώσκω.d: I read, know again, know certainly, recognize, discern.

πρόθεσις.d: a setting forth, the show-bread; predetermination, purpose.

ἐμπίπτω.g: I fall in, am cast in
ἐμπίπτω.d: I fall in, am cast in, am involved in.

ἀποκαθίστημι.d: I set up again, restore to its original position or condition; hence: I restore, give back.

συμβούλιον.d: (a) a body of advisers (assessors) in a court, a council, (b) abstr: consultation, counsel, advice; resolution, decree.

φανερός.d: apparent, clear, visible, manifest; adv: clearly.

συντρίβω.d: I break by crushing, break in pieces, shatter, crush, bruise.

κατάγνυμι.d: I break down (in pieces), crush, break into.

σβέννυμι.d: (a) I extinguish, quench, (b) I suppress, thwart.

ἐλπίζω.d: I hope, hope for, expect, trust.

ἐξίστημι.d: (lit: I remove from a standing position), (a) in trans. tenses: I astonish, amaze, (b) in intrans. tenses: I am astonished, amazed; I am out of my mind, am mad.

μερίζω.d: I divide into parts, divide, part, share, distribute; mid: I share, take part in a partitioning; I distract.

ἐρημόομαι.d: (a) I make desolate, bring to desolation, destroy, waste, (b) of a person: I strip, rob.

φθάνω.d: (a) I anticipate, precede, (b) I come, arrive.

σκεῦος.g: a vessel to contain liquid, utensil, tackle
σκεῦος.d: a vessel to contain liquid; a vessel of mercy or wrath; any instrument by which anything is done; a household utensil; of ships: tackle.

σκορπίζω.d: I disperse, scatter abroad (as of sheep); I dissipate, waste; I distribute alms.

αἰών.g: an age, a cycle of time
αἰών.d: an age, a cycle (of time), especially of the present age as contrasted with the future age, and of one of a series of ages stretching to infinity.

σημεῖον.d: a sign, miracle, indication, mark, token.

μοιχαλίς.d: (a) an adulteress (that is, a married woman who commits adultery), (b) Hebraistically: extended to those who worship any other than the true God.

κοιλία.d: belly, abdomen, heart, a general term covering any organ in the abdomen, e.g. stomach, womb; met: the inner man.

κῆτος.d: a sea monster, huge sea fish, whale.

Νινευίτης.d: a Ninevite, an inhabitant of Nineveh, a city on the Tigris in Assyria.

κατακρίνω.d: I condemn, judge worthy of punishment.

πέρας.d: (a) a boundary, limit, extremity, (b) an end, conclusion.

διέρχομαι.g: I pass through, spread a report
διέρχομαι.d: I pass through, spread (as a report).

ἄνυδρος.d: without water, dry; subst: dry places, desert.

τόπος.d: a place, region, seat; an opportunity.

σχολάζω.d: (a) I have leisure, (b) I stand empty (of a house).

κοσμέω.d: I put into order; I decorate, deck, adorn.

ἀδελφή.d: a sister, a woman (fellow-)member of a church, a Christian woman.

αἰγιαλός.d: sea-coast, (sandy) beach; shore (of sea or lake), land.

παραβολή.d: (a) a comparison, (b) a parable, often of those uttered by our Lord, (c) a proverb, an adage.

κατεσθίω.g: I eat till it is finished
κατεσθίω.d: I eat up, eat till it is finished, devour, squander, annoy, injure.

ἐξανατέλλω.d: I rise (spring) up out (of the ground).

βάθος.d: depth; deep water; met: fullness, immensity; an extreme degree; profundities, deep-laid plans.

ξηραίνω.d: I dry up, parch, am ripened, wither, waste away.

πνίγω.d: I choke, throttle, strangle; hence: I drown.

μυστήριον.d: a mystery, secret, of which initiation is necessary; in the NT: the counsels of God, once hidden but now revealed in the Gospel or some fact thereof; the Christian revelation generally; particular truths or details of the Christian revelation.

ἀναπληρόω.g: I fill up, make up, fulfill
ἀναπληρόω.d: I fill up, make up, complete the measure of, fulfill, carry out the commands (provisions, etc.) of.

προφητεία.d: prophecy, prophesying; the gift of communicating and enforcing revealed truth.

παχύνομαι.d: I fatten, thicken; pass. fig: I become stupid, dull, unfeeling.

πλοῦτος.d: riches, wealth, abundance, materially or spiritually.

συμπνίγω.d: I choke utterly, as weeds do plants; I crowd upon.

δή.d: (a) in a clause expressing demand: so, then, (b) indeed, (c) truly.

παρατίθημι.g: I set before, serve, entrust to
παρατίθημι.d: (a) I set (especially a meal) before, serve, (b) act. and mid: I deposit with, entrust to, (c) I bring forward, quote as evidence.

σπέρμα.d: (a) seed, commonly of cereals, (b) offspring, descendents.

ζιζάνιον.d: spurious wheat, darnel; a plant that grows in Palestine which resembles wheat in many ways but is worthless.

ἀνά.g: and, apiece, by, each, every, in, through
ἀνά.d: prep. Rare in NT; prop: upwards, up; among, between; in turn; apiece, by; as a prefix: up, to, anew, back.

βλαστάνω.g: I sprout, cause to sprout, make to grow up
βλαστάνω.d: intrans: I sprout; trans: I cause to sprout, make to grow up.

ἐκριζόω.d: I root out, pluck up by the roots.

ἅμα.g: at the same time, along with
ἅμα.d: at the same time, therewith, along with, together with.

σίναπι.d: mustard (probably the shrub, not the herb).

κατασκηνόω.d: I encamp, take up my quarters, tabernacle, pitch my tent, dwell.

κλάδος.d: a young tender shoot, then: a branch; met: of descendants.

ζύμη.d: leaven, ferment, both lit. and met.

σάτον.d: a large measure equal to nearly three English gallons.

ἐρεύγομαι.d: (lit: I belch forth, hence) I utter, declare.

καταβολή.d: (a) foundation, (b) depositing, sowing, deposit, technically used of the act of conception.

σκάνδαλον.d: a snare, stumbling-block, cause for error.

ἔμπορος.d: a merchant, trader; one on a journey.

πολύτιμος.d: of great value, very costly, very precious.

πιπράσκω.d: I sell; pass: I am a slave to, am devoted to.

ἀναβιβάζω.d: I draw up, as a net to shore.

ἀφορίζω.g: I rail off, separate, place apart
ἀφορίζω.d: I rail off, separate, place apart.

μαθητεύω.g: I make disciples, make into disciples
μαθητεύω.d: I make a disciple of, train in discipleship; pass: I am trained, discipled, instructed.

μεταίρω.g: I change my position, depart, remove
μεταίρω.d: I change my position, depart, remove.

Μαριάμ.d: Mary, Miriam, (a) the mother of Jesus, (b) of Magdala, (c) sister of Martha and Lazarus, (d) wife of Cleopas, (e) mother of John Mark, (f) a Christian woman in Rome.

τετραάρχης.d: a tetrarch, ruler over a fourth part of a region.

ἐνεργέω.d: I work, am operative, am at work, am made to work, accomplish; mid: I work, display activity.

ἀποτίθημι.g: I lay off or aside, renounce
ἀποτίθημι.d: I lay off or aside, renounce, stow away, put.

Ἡρῳδιάς.d: Herodias (died after A.D. 40), daughter of Aristobulus and granddaughter of Herod I, wife, first, of her uncle Herod, second, of his half-brother, her uncle Herod Antipas.

ἀρέσκω.d: I please, with the idea of willing service rendered to others; hence almost: I serve.

προβιβάζω.d: I lead forward, lead on; met: I induce, incite, urge.

φέρω.d: I carry, bear, bring; I conduct, lead; perhaps: I make publicly known.

πτῶμα.d: a fall; a carcass, corpse, dead body.

εὐλογέω.d: (lit: I speak well of) I bless; pass: I am blessed.

πλήρης.d: full, abounding in, complete, completely occupied with.

φόβος.d: (a) fear, terror, alarm, (b) the object or cause of fear, (c) reverence, respect.

καταποντίζομαι.g: I sink in the sea, am drowned
καταποντίζομαι.d: I sink in the sea, pass: I drown, am submerged.

ἐπιλαμβάνομαι.d: I lay hold of, take hold of, seize (sometimes with beneficent, sometimes with hostile, intent).

κοπάζω.d: I abate, cease raging, am stilled.

Γεννησαρέτ.d: Gennesaret, a fertile district by the lake of Tiberias, which was in consequence sometimes called the Lake of Gennesaret.

διασῴζω.d: I save (rescue) through (some danger), bring safely to, escaped to.

πρεσβύτερος.d: elder, usually used as subst.; an elder, a member of the Sanhedrin, an elder of a Christian assembly.

τιμάω.g: I value at a price, honor
τιμάω.d: (a) I value at a price, estimate, (b) I honor, reverence.

κακολογέω.d: I speak evil of, curse, revile, abuse.

ὠφελέω.d: I help, benefit, do good, am useful (to), profit.

ἀκυρόω.g: I annul, make of no effect, cancel
ἀκυρόω.d: I annul, make of no effect, cancel.

χεῖλος.d: a lip, mouth, shore, edge, brink; meton: language, dialect.

πόρρω.d: far, far off, at a distance.

μάτην.d: in vain, in an unreal way, to no purpose.

κοινόω.g: I make unclean, regard as unclean
κοινόω.d: I make unclean, pollute, desecrate, mid: I regard (treat) as unclean.

φυτεία.d: a plant, that which is planted.

ὁδηγός.d: a leader, guide; met: an instructor, teacher.

ὁδηγέω.d: I lead, guide; met: I instruct, teach.

ἀσύνετος.d: unintelligent, without wisdom, unwise, undiscerning (implying probably moral defect).

νοέω.d: I understand, think, consider, conceive, apprehend; aor. possibly: realize.

εἰσπορεύομαι.d: I journey in(to), I go in(to), enter, intervene.

χωρέω.d: (lit: I make room, hence) (a) I have room for, receive, contain, (b) I make room for by departing, go, make progress, turn myself.

κἀκεῖνος.g: and he, she, it, and that
κἀκεῖνος.d: and he, she, it, and that.

διαλογισμός.d: a calculation, reasoning, thought, movement of thought, deliberation, plotting.

Χαναναῖος.d: Canaanite, a Biblical and archaic name for Phoenician.

ἐρωτάω.d: (a) I ask (a question), question, (b) I request, make a request to, pray.

βοηθέω.g: I come to the rescue of
βοηθέω.d: I come to the rescue of, come to help, help.

κυνάριον.d: a little dog, a house dog.

τράπεζα.g: a table for food or business
τράπεζα.d: a table, (a) for food or banqueting, (b) for money-changing or business.

ὦ.d: O, an exclamation, used in addressing someone.

κυλλός.d: crippled, lame, especially in the hands.

προσμένω.d: I remain; I abide in, remain in, persist in, adhere to.

ἐκλύομαι.g: I am unstrung, become weak, fail
ἐκλύομαι.d: I loose, release, unloose (as a bow-string), relax, enfeeble; pass: I am faint, grow weary.

ἐρημία.d: a desert place, desert, uninhabited region.

ἀναπίπτω.g: I lie down, recline, fall back upon
ἀναπίπτω.d: I lie down, recline (at a dinner-table), fall back upon (the breast of another person reclining at dinner).

εὐχαριστέω.d: I thank, give thanks; pass. 3 sing: is received with thanks.

ἐπιδείκνυμι.d: I show, display, point out, indicate; I prove, demonstrate.

πρωΐ.g: early in the morning, at dawn
πρωΐ.d: early in the morning, at dawn.

χειμών.d: a storm, tempest; winter, the rainy season.

στυγνάζω.d: I am gloomy, have a somber countenance, am shocked.

διακρίνω.d: I separate, distinguish, discern one thing from another; I doubt, hesitate, waver.

μνημονεύω.d: I remember, hold in remembrance, make mention of.

Καισάρεια.d: Two cities of Palestine: one in Galilee (Caesarea Philippi), the other on the coast of the Mediterranean.

σάρξ.d: flesh, body, human nature, materiality; kindred.

ἐκκλησία.d: an assembly, congregation, church; the Church, the whole body of Christian believers.

κατισχύω.g: I prevail against, overpower, am able
κατισχύω.d: I prevail against, overpower, get the upper hand.

διαστέλλομαι.d: I give a commission (instructions), order; I admonish, prohibit.

πάσχω.d: I am acted upon in a certain way, either good or bad; I experience ill treatment, suffer.

προσλαμβάνομαι.d: (a) I take to myself, (b) I take aside, (c) I welcome.

φρονέω.d: (a) I think, (b) I think, judge, (c) I direct the mind to, seek for, (d) I observe, (e) I care for.

ἀπαρνέομαι.d: I deny, disown, repudiate (either another person or myself), disregard.

κερδαίνω.d: I gain, acquire, win (over), avoid loss.

ζημιόω.d: I inflict loss (damage) upon, fine, punish, sometimes with the acc. of the penalty, even when the verb is passive.

ἕκαστος.d: each (of more than two), every one.

πρᾶξις.d: (a) a doing, action, mode of action; plur: deeds, acts, (b) function, business.

ἀναφέρω.g: I carry up, lead up, offer up
ἀναφέρω.d: (a) I carry up, lead up, (b) I offer up (on a high altar) as a sacrifice, offer up to God on high.

σκηνή.d: a tent, booth, tabernacle, abode, dwelling, mansion, habitation.

ὅραμα.d: a spectacle, vision, that which is seen.

γονυπετέω.g: I fall on my knees before, supplicate, entreat
γονυπετέω.d: I fall on my knees before (in supplication), supplicate, entreat.

ἄπιστος.d: unbelieving, incredulous, unchristian; sometimes subst: unbeliever.

ἀνέχομαι.d: I endure, bear with, have patience with, suffer, admit, persist.

ἀδυνατέω.d: to be impossible; I am unable.

δίδραχμον.d: a double-drachma, two drachmae, a Greek silver coin.

ἀλλότριος.d: belonging to another person, belonging to others, foreign, strange.

πρᾶγμα.d: a thing done, a deed, action; a matter, an affair.

συναίρω.g: I make a reckoning, settle accounts
συναίρω.d: I compare (settle) accounts, make a reckoning.

μακροθυμέω.d: I suffer long, have patience, am forbearing, perseverance.

βασανιστής.d: one who tortures, a tormentor, jailor.

αἰτία.d: a cause, reason, excuse; a charge, accusation; guilt; circumstances, case.

νεανίσκος.d: a young man, youth, an attendant.

τρύπημα.d: a hole; the eye of a needle.

ὡσαύτως.d: in like manner, likewise, just so.

γογγύζω.d: I whisper, murmur, grumble (generally of smoldering discontent).

σταυρόω.d: I fix to the cross, crucify; fig: I destroy, mortify.

λύτρον.d: the purchasing money for manumitting slaves, a ransom, the price of ransoming; especially the sacrifice by which expiation is effected, an offering of expiation.

σιωπάω.d: I keep silence, am silent, either voluntarily or involuntarily.

ὑποζύγιον.d: a beast of burden, an ass or mule.

προσευχή.d: (a) prayer (to God), (b) a place for prayer (used by Jews, perhaps where there was no synagogue).

αὐλίζομαι.d: I lodge in the open, lodge, pass the night.

ἐπανάγω.d: (a) nautical: I put out (from the shore), (lit: I take up a ship on to the high seas), (b) I go up, possibly: I go up again, return.

μεταμέλομαι.d: (lit: I change one care or interest for another), I change my mind (generally for the better), repent, regret.

δεύτερος.d: second; with the article: in the second place, for the second time.

περιτίθημι.d: I place or put around, clothe; fig: I bestow, confer.

ἐκδίδωμι.d: I give out, let; middle: I let out for my own advantage.

γεωργός.g: a worker of the soil, husbandman, vine-dresser
γεωργός.d: a worker of the soil, husbandman, farmer, farm-laborer, vine-dresser.

λιθοβολέω.d: I stone, cast stones (at), kill by stoning.

ἐντρέπω.d: (a) I turn to confusion, put to shame, (b) mid: I reverence, regard.

κακός.d: bad, evil, in the widest sense.

γραφή.d: (a) a writing, (b) a passage of scripture; plur: the scriptures.

συνθλάομαι.d: I break, break in pieces, crush, shatter.

λικμάω.d: I crush to powder, scatter like chaff.

γάμος.d: a marriage, wedding, wedding-ceremony; plur: a wedding-feast.

θύω.d: I sacrifice, generally an animal; hence: I kill.

ἀμελέω.d: I neglect, am careless of, disregard.

λοιπός.d: left, left behind, the remainder, the rest, the others.

διέξοδος.g: a public spot in a city
διέξοδος.d: a meeting-place of roads, a public spot in a city.

κλητός.d: called, invited, summoned by God to an office or to salvation.

Ἡρῳδιανοί.g: the Herodians, the partisans of Herod Antipas
Ἡρῳδιανοί.d: the Herodians, the partisans of Herod (Antipas).

μέλει.g: it is a care, it concerns
μέλει.d: it is a care, it is an object of anxiety, it concerns.

ἐπιγαμβρεύω.g: I marry a deceased brother's wife
ἐπιγαμβρεύω.d: I take to wife after, marry a deceased brother's wife.

ὁμοίως.d: in like manner, similarly, in the same way, equally.

νομικός.g: about law, one learned in the Law
νομικός.d: (a) adj: connected with law, about law, (b) noun: a lawyer, one learned in the Law, one learned in the Old Testament.

τολμάω.d: I dare, endure, am bold, have courage, make up the mind.

δεσμεύω.d: I bind, put in chains, tie together.

βαρύς.d: heavy, weighty, burdensome, lit. and met; violent, oppressive.

κινέω.d: I set in motion, move, remove, excite, stir up.

πλατύνω.d: I enlarge, make broad; met: of the growth of tenderness and love.

μεγαλύνω.d: (a) I enlarge, lengthen, (b) I increase, magnify, extol.

πρωτοκλισία.g: the chief place at a banquet
πρωτοκλισία.d: the chief place at a banquet or table.

δεῖπνον.g: a dinner, an afternoon or evening meal
δεῖπνον.d: a dinner, an afternoon or evening meal.

ῥαββί.d: Rabbi, my master, teacher; a title of respect often applied to Christ.

προσήλυτος.d: (lit: that has come to), a proselyte, that is a non-Jew, who has been circumcised and has adopted the Jews' religion.

ναός.d: a temple, a shrine, that part of the temple where God himself resides.

ἀποδεκατόω.g: I take off a tenth part, pay tithe
ἀποδεκατόω.d: I take off (deduct) a tenth part (of my property) (and give it away), pay tithe.

κύμινον.d: cumin, a plant used as a spice.

διϋλίζω.g: I strain, put through a sieve
διϋλίζω.d: I strain, put through a sieve.

κώνωψ.d: a gnat, mosquito, referred to proverbially as something small.

καταπίνω.d: I drink down, swallow, devour, destroy, consume.

ἔξωθεν.d: (a) from outside, from without, (b) outside, both as adj. and prep; with article: the outside.

παροψίς.d: prop: a dainty side-dish; meton: a plate, dish, platter.

ἁρπαγή.g: the act of plundering, plunder, spoil
ἁρπαγή.d: the act of plundering; plunder, spoil, robbery.

ἀκρασία.d: incontinence, intemperance (in wide sense), lack of restraint.

ἐκτός.g: without, outside, except, the outside, apart from
ἐκτός.d: (a) adv: (1) without, outside, beyond, (2) except, (3) subst: the outside, (b) prep: outside, apart from.

ὑπόκρισις.d: (lit: stage-playing), a response, answer, hypocrisy, dissembling.

μαρτυρέω.d: I witness, bear witness, give evidence, testify, give a good report.

τρόπος.d: (a) way, manner, (b) manner of life, character.

νοσσίον.g: a nestling, the young of birds
νοσσίον.d: a nestling, the young of birds.

οἰκοδομή.g: the act of building, a building, edification
οἰκοδομή.d: (a) the act of building, (b) a building, (c) met: spiritual advancement, edification.

παρουσία.d: (a) presence, (b) a coming, an arrival, advent, especially of the second coming of Christ.

θροέομαι.d: I disturb, agitate; pass: I am troubled, alarmed.

ὠδίν.g: the pain of childbirth, severe agony
ὠδίν.d: the pain of childbirth, acute pain, severe agony, a snare.

ψύχομαι.d: I cool, pass: I grow cold.

ἀγάπη.d: love, benevolence, good will, esteem; plur: love-feasts.

βδέλυγμα.d: an abominable thing, an accursed thing.

νῦν.d: adv. (a) of time: just now, even now; just at hand, immediately, (b) of logical connection: now then, (c) in commands and appeals: at this instant.

κολοβόω.d: (lit: I maim, mutilate), I cut short, shorten, abbreviate.

προλέγω.d: I tell (say) beforehand, forewarn, declare, tell plainly.

ἀστραπή.g: a flash of lightning, brightness, luster
ἀστραπή.d: a flash of lightning, brightness, luster.

σάλπιγξ.d: a trumpet, the sound of a trumpet.

ἁπαλός.d: soft, tender, as a shoot of a tree.

ἐκφύω.g: I put forth, cause to sprout
ἐκφύω.d: I put forth, cause to sprout.

τρώγω.d: I eat, partake of a meal.

ἄχρι.g: as far as, up to, until
ἄχρι.d: as far as, up to, until, during.

κιβωτός.d: (properly: a wooden box, hence) the Ark, in which Noah sailed; the Ark of the Covenant.

γρηγορέω.g: I am awake, am vigilant, watch
γρηγορέω.d: (a) I am awake (in the night), watch, (b) I am watchful, on the alert, vigilant.

ἐάω.d: I allow, permit, let alone, leave.

καθίστημι.d: I set down, bring down to a place; I set in order, appoint, make, constitute.

χρονίζω.d: I delay, tarry, linger, spend time.

τύπτω.g: I beat, strike, wound, inflict punishment
τύπτω.d: I beat, strike, wound, inflict punishment.

μεθύω.d: I am intoxicated with wine, am drunk.

διχοτομέω.g: I cut in two, scourge severely
διχοτομέω.d: I cut in two, perhaps: scourge severely.

νυστάζω.g: I nod in sleep, am drowsy, slumber
νυστάζω.d: I nod in sleep, am drowsy, slumber.

κραυγή.d: (a) a shout, cry, clamor, (b) outcry, clamoring against another.

ἀπάντησις.g: the act of meeting, to meet
ἀπάντησις.d: the act of meeting, to meet (a phrase seemingly almost technical for the reception of a newly arrived official).

ἀρκέω.g: I am sufficient, I suffice, am content, satisfied
ἀρκέω.d: I keep off, assist; I suffice; pass: I am satisfied.

ἀργύριον.g: silver, a shekel, money in general
ἀργύριον.d: silver, a piece of silver, a shekel, money in general.

εὖ.d: well, well done, good, rightly; also used as an exclamation.

ὀκνηρός.d: slothful, backward, hesitating; of things: irksome.

κομίζω.d: (a) act: I convey, bring, carry, (b) mid: I receive back, receive what has belonged to myself but has been lost, or else promised but kept back, or: I get what has come to be my own by earning, recover.

ξένος.d: alien, new, novel; noun: a guest, stranger, foreigner.

γυμνός.d: rarely: stark-naked; generally: wearing only the under-garment; bare, open, manifest; mere.

ἐπισκέπτομαι.g: I look upon, visit, look out, select
ἐπισκέπτομαι.d: I look upon, visit, look out, select.

ἀσθενής.d: (lit: not strong), (a) weak (physically, or morally), (b) infirm, sick.

κόλασις.d: chastisement, punishment, torment, perhaps with the idea of deprivation.

πάσχα.g: the feast of Passover, the Passover lamb
πάσχα.d: the feast of Passover, the Passover lamb.

αὐλή.d: court-yard, fore-court, sheep-fold; but it may be understood as: palace, house.

συμβουλεύω.d: I give advice, exhort; mid: I take counsel together, consult.

θόρυβος.d: (a) din, hubbub, confused noise, outcry, (b) riot, disturbance.

ἀλάβαστρον.d: a phial or bottle of perfumed ointment, usually of alabaster.

κόπος.d: (a) trouble, (b) toil, labor, laborious toil, involving weariness and fatigue.

παρέχω.d: act. and mid: I offer, provide, confer, afford, give, bring, show, cause.

ἄζυμος.d: unleavened, the paschal feast (a feast of the Hebrews); fig: uncorrupted, sincere.

δεῖνα.g: so and so, such a one
δεῖνα.d: so and so, such a one, where the name of the person is known but not used.

διαθήκη.d: (a) a covenant between two parties, (b) (the ordinary, everyday sense [found a countless number of times in papyri]) a will, testament.

ἄφεσις.d: a sending away, a letting go, a release, pardon, complete forgiveness.

ὑμνέω.d: I sing, sing hymns to, praise.

πατάσσω.d: I smite, strike (as with a sword), smite to death, afflict.

χωρίον.g: a place, piece of land, field
χωρίον.d: a place, piece of land, field, property, estate.

Γεθσημανί.d: Gethsemane, a small place between the brook Kidron and the Mount of Olives near Jerusalem.

ἀδημονέω.d: I feel fear, lack courage, am distressed, troubled.

προέρχομαι.d: I go forward, go on, advance; I go before, precede.

βαρέω.d: I weight, load, burden, lit. and met.

ξύλον.g: a staff, cross, anything made of wood
ξύλον.d: anything made of wood, a piece of wood, a club, staff; the trunk of a tree, used to support the cross-bar of a cross in crucifixion.

πάρειμι.d: I am present, am near; I have come, arrived.

ἀποσπάω.g: I wrench away from, drag away, withdraw
ἀποσπάω.d: lit: I wrench away from, drag away, but perhaps sometimes in the well-attested weakened sense: I am parted or withdrawn.

παρίστημι.g: I bring, present, come up to and stand by
παρίστημι.d: I bring, present, prove, come up to and stand by, am present.

λεγιών.d: properly: a division of the Roman army, numbering about 6,000 infantry with additional cavalry; hence: a very large number; a legion.

συλλαμβάνω.d: I seize, apprehend, assist, conceive, become pregnant.

καθέζομαι.g: I am sitting, sit, am seated
καθέζομαι.d: I am sitting, sit down, am seated.

ἔσω.d: within, inside, with verbs either of rest or of motion; prep: within, to within, inside.

ἐξορκίζω.d: I adjure, put to oath; I exorcise.

κολαφίζω.g: I strike with the fist, maltreat
κολαφίζω.d: I strike with the fist, buffet; hence: I mistreat violently.

παιδίσκη.d: a female slave, maidservant, maid, young girl.

Γαλιλαῖος.d: a Galilean, an inhabitant of Galilee.

πυλών.g: a large gate, a gateway, porch
πυλών.d: a large gate; a gateway, porch, vestibule.

λαλιά.d: (in classical Greek: babble, chattering) speech, talk; manner of speech, dialect.

ἀπάγχομαι.d: I choke, strangle; mid: I strangle or hang myself.

εἴωθα.g: I am accustomed, custom, what was customary
εἴωθα.d: I am accustomed, custom, what was customary.

βῆμα.g: the space covered by a step of the foot, a tribunal
βῆμα.d: an elevated place ascended by steps, a throne, tribunal.

ἀπέναντι.g: over against, opposite, in view of, in the presence of
ἀπέναντι.d: against, over against, opposite, in view of, in the presence of.

πραιτώριον.g: the official residence of the procurator
πραιτώριον.d: the palace at Jerusalem occupied by the Roman governor, or the quarters of the praetorian guard in Rome.

σπεῖρα.d: a cohort, the tenth part of a legion; a military guard.

ἐκδύω.g: I put off, take off, strip off
ἐκδύω.d: I put off, take off, strip off, with acc. of person or garment or both.

χλαμύς.d: a short cloak, worn by military officers and soldiers.

κόκκινος.d: crimson, scarlet, dyed with Kermes (coccum), the female coccus of the Kermes oak.

πλέκω.d: I weave together, plait, twist, braid.

Γολγοθᾶ.d: Golgotha, a knoll outside the wall of Jerusalem.

διαμερίζω.g: I divide up into parts, break up, distribute
διαμερίζω.d: I divide up into parts, break up; I distribute.

κλῆρος.d: (a) a lot, (b) a portion assigned; hence: a portion of the people of God assigned to one's care, a congregation.

παραπορεύομαι.d: I go past, pass by, pass along by.

ἀναβοάω.g: I shout upwards, cry out, raise my voice
ἀναβοάω.d: I shout upwards, cry out, raise my voice.

ἐγκαταλείπω.d: I leave in the lurch, abandon (one who is in straits), desert.

τρέχω.d: I run, exercise myself, make progress.

ὄξος.d: vinegar, sour wine mixed with water, a common drink of Roman soldiers.

ἄνωθεν.g: from above, from the beginning, again
ἄνωθεν.d: (a) from above, from heaven, (b) from the beginning, from their origin (source), from of old, (c) again, anew.

κοιμάομαι.d: I fall asleep, am asleep, sometimes of the sleep of death.

ἐμφανίζω.g: I make visible, report against, appear before
ἐμφανίζω.d: I make visible (manifest); hence: I report (inform) against; pass: I appear before.

θεωρέω.d: I look at, gaze, behold; I see, experience, discern; I partake of.

ἐντυλίσσω.g: I wrap up, roll round, envelop
ἐντυλίσσω.d: I wrap up, roll round, envelop.
